quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Yao Jinlong (Zhejiang listed companies' collective 2025 annual results briefing), asked whether high-speed copper connections and CPO can coexist: from an industry perspective, different technologies and products will fit different application scenarios and develop together over the long term; the company will track frontier technology, deepen strategic cooperation with leading domestic and overseas customers and position itself in AI compute.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhaolong Interconnect results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual collective (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vice president and board secretary Yao Yunping (2025 annual results briefing): the company's optical products are in volume production, aimed mainly at mid-to-high-end data-center applications - overseas it is expanding in Europe, North America and Southeast Asia, and in China it focuses on banks, leading internet companies and telecom operators; its automotive data cables are in small-batch production while it supports end customers' factory audits and product validation ahead of mass production.
